positions.description:

projects.title: Lazy Bat File
projects.description: Participated in a Hackathon where we created a program that allowed users with minimal computer experience to create ".bat" files that allowed them to open multiple programs at once. The program was created using the "tkinter" Python library for the graphical user interface and Python for the back-end.

projects.title: Social Media Bot
projects.description:
• Designed and implemented a bot (in Python) that retrieves top images from Reddit and
posts to social media platforms.
• Gained valuable insight into how the Facebook Graph API works, how websites interact
with bots and how to bypass some restrictions on bots.
